caption:
Anthropic is set to deploy 2 gigawatts of AMD GPUs in a deal valued at up to $5 billion. The partnership aims to enhance its Claude models with advanced hardware. The first phase of this deal will kick off in 2027! 💻🔋

How will this impact the AI landscape?
